description: The sanctioned common Rust UI framework: one codebase to web (WASM), desktop, iOS and Android. Chosen over Leptos/Yew (web-only) because it is the single Rust option that reaches mobile native. Dioxus 0.7 ships Tailwind and Radix support, which is Mzizi's exact primitive stack (Tailwind + Radix + CVA), so the primitive surface maps across rather than being re-invented. This is Rust-as-UI — distinct from Rust-as-shared-core (the WASM harness, N5 resilience state machine and N4 safety gates), which is not a component source at all.
name: Dioxus (Rust, web + mobile native)
tier_note: Rust across web and mobile native — the direction. Primary once primitives are wired; readiness still governs whether source exists.
